season.rationale: The season starts with a low-intensity rebuild and fat-loss foundation after the 1130 km bikepacking race and detraining, using easy volume, strength technique, hip mobility, and nutrition habits. A short vault-specific power block precedes the January 7 pole vault world championship, followed by an aerobic rebuild and winter base. The plan then builds general cycling fitness and endurance, peaks for the April 200 km brevet and August 2027 Paris-Brest-Paris, while periodizing indoor cycling, running, hiking, rowing, staircase, and strength work to avoid unnecessary volume.

block.rationale: After the 1130 km bikepacking race and detraining, this block starts with very low intensity and conservative strength work to protect the back and hips while building fat-loss and training habits. Progression is gradual through easy volume and strength technique before advancing to the next block. The new week starting 2026-10-26 is a recovery-focused re-entry week following a large mountain hike on 2026-10-25, so volume and intensity remain very low ahead of the 5-hour hike on 2026-11-01.

block.rationale: After the 1130 km bikepacking race and subsequent detraining, this block starts with very low intensity and conservative strength work to protect the back and hips while building fat-loss and training habits. The coach recently shifted the near-term plan after the January 7 pole vault world championship, prioritizing short sprints, plyometrics, and posterior-chain loading while keeping easy cycling and fat-loss habits as supporting volume. The December weeks are revised toward vault-specific preparation with a taper into January 7, followed by return to the aerobic rebuild.
